user.title: Victron Charge Control
user.description: Select your Victron and EPEX Spot entities. Fields marked required must be configured. Optional fields can be left empty. The expected units are shown in each label.

data.epex_spot_entity: EPEX Spot price sensor (required, ct/kWh or EUR/kWh)
data.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: DC coupled PV feed-in switch (optional, on/off)
data.grid_consumer_entity: Grid Consumer power sensor (optional, W or kW)

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Choose the sensor that shows the battery charge level (0-100%). Used to keep the battery within your charge limits.
data_description.grid_setpoint_entity: Choose the permanent Victron ESS AC power setpoint in watts (W). It stays at your Idle Setpoint as a fallback when active control stops.
data_description.epex_spot_entity: Choose the EPEX Spot price sensor in ct/kWh or EUR/kWh. It must include future prices in its attributes for automatic scheduling.
data_description.max_grid_feed_in_entity: Choose the Victron ESS setting for maximum power sent to the grid, in watts (W). Used to limit feed-in based on electricity prices.
data_description.grid_consumption_entity: Choose the meter that shows the total energy bought from the grid in kWh. Used to track energy use and cost. Leave empty to skip tracking.
data_description.grid_feed_in_energy_entity: Choose the meter that shows the total energy sent to the grid in kWh. Used to track energy sold and money earned. Leave empty to skip tracking.
data_description.solar_surplus_entity: Choose the sensor that shows unused solar power in watts (W). Used for Grid Consumer, solar charging, and discharge control. Leave empty if you do not use these features.
data_description.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: Choose the Victron DC-coupled PV feed-in switch. When this control is enabled, the switch turns off in reduced feed-in mode and on in normal mode. Leave empty to skip this control.
data_description.grid_consumer_entity: Choose the power sensor for a device you want to supply from solar and the grid. When Grid Consumer is enabled, the grid covers the power that unused solar cannot supply, within your set limits. Leave empty to disable this feature.
data_description.ac_grid_setpoint_entity: Choose the AC grid setpoint (RAM) in watts (W) from the built-in Victron GX integration. Active control uses this value. Choose a different entity from the permanent AC power setpoint. If this entity becomes unavailable, the safety watchdog stops control.

reconfigure.title: Victron Charge Control
reconfigure.description: Select both distinct setpoint entities to resume control. Existing schedules and settings are preserved. The permanent AC power setpoint is the idle fallback; active targets use the RAM AC grid setpoint.

init.title: Victron Charge Control — Settings
init.description: Update your Victron and EPEX Spot entities. Fields marked required must be configured. Optional fields can be left empty. The expected units are shown in each label.

data.grid_setpoint_entity: AC power setpoint (permanent idle fallback, required, W)
data.epex_spot_entity: EPEX Spot price sensor (required, ct/kWh or EUR/kWh)
data.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: DC coupled PV feed-in switch (optional, on/off)
data.grid_consumer_entity: Grid Consumer power sensor (optional, W or kW)
data.ac_grid_setpoint_entity: AC grid setpoint (RAM active control, required, W)

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Choose the sensor that shows the battery charge level (0-100%). Used to keep the battery within your charge limits.
data_description.grid_setpoint_entity: Choose the permanent Victron ESS AC power setpoint in watts (W). It stays at your Idle Setpoint as a fallback when active control stops.

data_description.dc_coupled_pv_feed_in_entity: Choose the Victron DC-coupled PV feed-in switch. When this control is enabled, the switch turns off in reduced feed-in mode and on in normal mode. Leave empty to skip this control.
data_description.safety_startup_grace_seconds: How long to wait for battery charge and grid setpoint readings after startup or reload (0-600 seconds; default 90). The wait ends as soon as both readings are valid. Set to 0 for no wait.
data_description.use_solcast_forecast: Use the saved Solcast solar forecast for today and tomorrow. Solcast is found automatically. This is on by default and only shows forecast information; it does not change charging or schedules.
